name: North Coast Post-Storm Survey LiDAR — March 2022 (3D)
description: Airborne LiDAR point cloud of the Causeway Coast, flown March 2022 as a post-storm survey in the DAERA NI 3D Coastal Survey programme, elevation-shaded. Recovered from the published ArcGIS i3s scene layer and streamed in 3D as an OGC 3D-Tiles octree via deck.gl: tilt and zoom in and the individual scanned points load in place; zoom out and they unload. Pairs with the September 2022 recovery survey for before/after comparison. (One central section of the corridor is omitted where the source scene layer could not be read.)
